_doc: Forest start post (user 25.10, docs/gdd/QUESTIONS_START.md): a lay-by for 2-3 cars and a guard post at the SPERRGEBIET gate. Frame: centre = the gate's package place (Forest_Layout ZoneGate), yaw = the gate's; u across the road (+u = north-east, downhill), v along it (+v = north-west, out of the zone). Metres. Only the 'level' rect plus its fades is edited on the terrain; padY is filled by the first run and then kept. Props' yaw is added to the frame's; a prefab's +Z (front) at yaw 90 faces the road (+u). No spare fuse on the desk any more (user 27.10: the van needs only fuel, its fuses are whole). The manual barrier (QUESTIONS_START 8; user 26.10: raised) stands 3.5 m before the gate on the approach side, its post by the booth, the arm raised (static until the post's interaction task). The post lamps carry a far halo the fog dims less (user 27.10, QUESTIONS_6 §7а 16: the post must read from the start ~80 m off), cold white, out with each lamp. The post lamps' battery lasts 40 min here (the game starts at 17:30 and is dark ~15 min later: the lamps and their halo must burn into the night). Rework 27.10 (docs/gdd/locations/start_post, all 9 proposals): the ground is Blender's (levelGround false, the pad follows the road's 8.7 % fall, 1:2 slopes; tools/blender_context/edits/forest_start_pad.py); the booth turned so its door faces the road and pad and its sign the approach; the car in the middle nose to the booth; crates, trash and tyres by the booth on the flat; the jersey blocks on the pad's far edge; a warm sodium pole lamp (the yard LightPole on its own battery, lamp.life) over the pad, the booth light warm, the tripod stays the cold light at the gate; rocks on the hill edge. Second round 27.10 (user, docs/gdd/locations/start_post concept_v2 pad_1 / night_1): smaller far halos (0.7 m, they were big white balls at night), the RADIOOBSERVATORIUM sign moved from mid-pad to the right verge inside the gate, its face to the players (moves) (the Sky Island sandbag wall was tried and dropped: a block wall out of style). The players' van stands on the road 14 m inside the gate, nose into the zone, its tank empty (van: ForestOpening spawns VanVehicle there in the forest start state; user 27.10, the van is filled from the booth's jerrycan); the players spawn on the road between the van and the post, looking at the post (clear of the van's body: a spawn inside it pushed it 20 m away) (spawn: PlayerSpawn and the spawn points follow). Package forest_start_post_v1 (29.10, Blender concept, targets concept_v3 arrive_wache + night_wache, QUESTIONS_3 all accepted): the booth gives way to the guard house StartWache.prefab (u -8.5, v -3.4, yaw 180: big window to the barrier, door to the road); the barrier turned (pivot at the house, arm over the road, raised) and set before the window inside the gate; props where the scene had them (export 28.10 21:41), the crates off the house corner, the tripod at the gate post, one pad lamp (dead: ForestStartPostStep); the wire barricade gone; the pad under snow (asphaltShare 0, pebbles 0).
